description: This file defines a PHP class 'EmployeePunchInOutMenuConfigurator' that implements menu configuration logic for the 'orangehrmAttendancePlugin' plugin, specifically for the employee punch in/out menu. It overrides certain module and screen settings when configured.

classes.name: EmployeePunchInOutMenuConfigurator
classes.description: A class responsible for configuring menu options related to employee punch in/out functionality within the OrangeHRM attendance plugin.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the default screen settings to set the module as 'time' and the screen as 'viewAttendanceRecord'.
